metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for remaining properties (Run 6 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms LayerZero message submission success
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzSend call in Verifier contract
2. Verify _lzSend reverts on submission failure
3. Confirm no success path without actual LZ submission
4. Check that gas parameters are sufficient for cross-chain delivery
5. Verify event emission only after successful submission

executable_checks.assertion: _lzSend is used for LayerZero submission

executable_checks.command: Review Verifier._lzSend implementation for error handling
executable_checks.assertion: Function reverts on submission failure
_lzSend failure causes transaction revert

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED -> Edge EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED. LayerZero submission confirmation. _lzSend reverts on failure ensuring transition only reached on success.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT updates transferRoots only after sender validation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Hub._lzReceive function
2. Trace control flow from message receipt to storage update
3. Verify srcEid validation precedes transferRoots assignment
4. Check no code paths bypass validation before storage
5. Confirm validation check uses revert on failure

executable_checks.assertion: Hub._lzReceive and transferRoots storage exist

executable_checks.command: Trace control flow in _lzReceive before transferRoots assignment
executable_checks.assertion: Validation check precedes storage update in all paths
Control flow graph shows validation before storage

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT -> Edge EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT. Validation-first pattern ensures unauthorized senders cannot update roots.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-ROOT-STORED event emits values matching storage
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate TransferRootUpdated event emission
2. Verify same values used for storage and event emission
3. Confirm event emission occurs in same transaction as storage
4. Check no modification between storage and event
5. Verify indexed parameters match storage keys

executable_checks.assertion: TransferRootUpdated event defined and emitted

executable_checks.command: Compare storage assignment values with event parameters
executable_checks.assertion: Identical values used for storage and event
Event parameters match stored values

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ROOT-STORED -> Edge EDGE-ROOT-STORED. Event/storage consistency for off-chain indexer reliability.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST maintains permissionless broadcast trigger
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate broadcast trigger function in Hub contract
2. Verify no access control modifiers restrict callers
3. Confirm any address can trigger broadcast
4. Check for economic barriers (gas limits, fees)
5. Verify no time-based restrictions preventing trigger

executable_checks.assertion: Broadcast function exists without access modifiers
No access control on broadcast function
Any address can trigger broadcast

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST -> Edge EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST. Permissionless broadcast ensures availability - delay is economic not security concern.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED initiates aggregation computation correctly
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate broadcast function aggregation logic
2. Verify aggregation computation is invoked
3. Check handling of empty root sets
4. Confirm gas consumption is bounded
5. Verify aggregation result is stored/emitted

executable_checks.assertion: Aggregation computation function exists
Broadcast initiates aggregation computation
Empty broadcast handled gracefully (wastes gas but valid)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED -> Edge EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED. Broadcast triggers aggregation. Empty broadcast is valid but economically wasteful.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED produces deterministic PoseidonT3 tree
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate aggregation function using PoseidonT3
2. Verify deterministic ordering of inputs
3. Confirm same inputs always produce same tree root
4. Check for any randomness or block-dependent values
5. Verify PoseidonT3 implementation matches specification

executable_checks.assertion: PoseidonT3 hash function is used
Same inputs produce identical aggregation root
Input ordering is deterministic (sorted or fixed order)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED -> Edge EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED. PoseidonT3 determinism ensures consistent tree construction.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED maintains strictly monotonic sequence
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate aggregation sequence counter
2. Verify only increment operation exists (no decrement/reset)
3. Confirm unchecked{++seq} pattern for gas efficiency
4. Check sequence is storage-backed (survives transactions)
5. Verify sequence is included in relevant events/logs

executable_checks.assertion: Aggregation sequence counter exists
No decrement or reset operations for sequence
Sequence strictly increases with each aggregation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED -> Edge EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED. Monotonic sequence ensures ordering for replay prevention.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED stores root in globalTransferRoots after validation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate globalTransferRoots storage mapping
2. Trace all write paths to this mapping
3. Verify each write is preceded by validation
4. Confirm validation checks source authenticity
5. Check no administrative backdoor for direct writes

executable_checks.assertion: globalTransferRoots mapping exists

executable_checks.command: Trace all assignment paths to globalTransferRoots
executable_checks.assertion: All paths require validation before storage
Invalid roots cannot be stored in globalTransferRoots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED -> Edge EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED. Validation-first pattern protects global root integrity.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH is client-side only operation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate stealth address generation in client SDK
2. Verify no network calls during generation
3. Confirm all cryptographic operations are local
4. Check no telemetry or logging of sensitive data
5. Verify randomness source is secure (CSPRNG)

executable_checks.assertion: Stealth generation function exists in client code
No network calls in stealth generation path

executable_checks.command: Review stealth address generation for network isolation
executable_checks.assertion: Generation is purely local computation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH -> Edge EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH. Client-side only ensures no identity leak during stealth generation.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED produces cryptographically bound stealth address
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate stealth address derivation function
2. Verify Poseidon hash is used for derivation
3. Confirm recipient public key is input to derivation
4. Check derivation is deterministic for same inputs
5. Verify stealth address cannot be unbound from recipient

executable_checks.assertion: Poseidon-based stealth derivation exists
Stealth address is deterministically derived from recipient

executable_checks.command: Verify stealth derivation formula matches specification
executable_checks.assertion: Derivation binds stealth to GeneralRecipient cryptographically

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED -> Edge EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED. Poseidon hash binding ensures stealth address is cryptographically tied to recipient.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED produces proof only from valid transfer history
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova IVC proof generation function
2. Verify Merkle proof validation against committed roots
3. Confirm circuit constraints enforce valid history
4. Check no bypass allows proof without valid transfers
5. Verify public inputs match committed state

executable_checks.assertion: Nova IVC proof generation exists

executable_checks.command: Review Nova circuit constraints for history validation
executable_checks.assertion: Circuit enforces Merkle proof verification
Proof generation fails for invalid transfer history

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED -> Edge EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED. Nova IVC soundness ensures proofs only for valid transfers.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER transmits only public proof data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate prover submission function in client
2. Verify only IVC commitments are sent (not witnesses)
3. Confirm private witness stays client-side
4. Check no debug/verbose mode leaks private data
5. Verify transport encryption for public data

executable_checks.assertion: Prover submission function exists

executable_checks.command: Review data sent to prover service
executable_checks.assertion: Only public commitments transmitted, no private witnesses
Private witness not included in submission payload

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER -> Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER. ZK property preserved - private witness stays client-side.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JOB-QUEUED maintains job ordering for fair processing
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate prover job queue implementation
2. Verify FIFO ordering for standard jobs
3. Check for any priority queue mechanisms
4. Confirm queue manipulation is not security-critical
5. Verify no starvation attacks possible

executable_checks.assertion: Job queue implementation exists
Queue maintains reasonable ordering (exact fairness is QoS not security)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JOB-QUEUED -> Edge EDGE-JOB-QUEUED. Queue fairness is service quality. Priority manipulation doesn't affect proof validity.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING maintains job isolation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate job processing worker implementation
2. Verify each job runs in isolated context
3. Confirm no shared mutable state between jobs
4. Check proving key is loaded fresh per job
5. Verify memory is cleared between jobs

executable_checks.assertion: Job processing function exists
Jobs have isolated contexts with no shared mutable state

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING -> Edge EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING. Job isolation prevents cross-job interference.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS uses correct proving key for circuit type
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IVC to Groth16 conversion function
2. Verify proving key selection based on circuit type
3. Confirm key mismatch causes generation failure
4. Check proving key integrity verification
5. Verify key loading is deterministic

executable_checks.assertion: Proving key loading and conversion exists
Key selection matches circuit type from IVC header

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS -> Edge EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS. Correct proving key ensures valid Groth16 conversion.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED returns valid Groth16 proof
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate job completion handler
2. Verify proof is locally verified before returning
3. Confirm verification uses same key as on-chain
4. Check proof structure matches expected format
5. Verify no partial/malformed proofs are returned

executable_checks.assertion: Proof verification before return exists

executable_checks.command: Review proof validation before job completion
executable_checks.assertion: Local verification ensures proof validity before return

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED -> Edge EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED. Groth16 completeness - prover verifies locally before returning.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JOB-FAILED returns error status without proof data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate job failure handler
2. Verify failure response has no proof field
3. Confirm error status is clearly indicated
4. Check no partial proof data leaks on failure
5. Verify failure reason is logged for debugging

executable_checks.assertion: Job failure handler exists
No proof field populated on failure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JOB-FAILED -> Edge EDGE-JOB-FAILED. Clean failure - error status without proof data.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT submits proof with matching public inputs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate teleport submission function in client
2. Verify public inputs are extracted from proof correctly
3. Confirm client validates inputs match before submission
4. Check mismatch results in verification failure
5. Verify clear error message on mismatch

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport submission function exists
Mismatched inputs cause verification failure (user error)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT -> Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT. User responsibility - mismatched inputs fail verification safely.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF checks root exists in mapping
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate root validation in teleport function
2. Verify lookup in provedRoots or globalTransferRoots
3. Confirm unknown root returns zero/false
4. Check comparison correctly rejects unknown roots
5. Verify no default values that could bypass check

executable_checks.assertion: Root validation mapping lookup exists
Unknown roots are rejected
Zero return from mapping lookup fails validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF -> Edge EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF. Root must exist in mapping - unknown roots fail lookup.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH binds proof to msg.sender
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate recipient hash computation in teleport
2. Verify formula: Poseidon(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak)
3. Confirm computed hash matches proof's public input
4. Check no bypass allows different sender to claim
5. Verify chain_id prevents cross-chain replay

executable_checks.assertion: Recipient hash computation exists
Different sender produces different hash, fails verification

executable_checks.command: Verify recipientHash formula matches proof circuit
executable_checks.assertion: On-chain and circuit recipient hash derivation match

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH -> Edge EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. Poseidon collision resistance binds proof to specific msg.sender.
